digest.component_or_area: Atomic postcondition coordinator for non-create dispatch
propositions: Compound legacy dispatch replays successful early work and conflates applied/deferred/failed outcomes; a provider-neutral coordinator must execute atomic desired postconditions once in dependency order per immutable plan

Late failure in multi-step postcondition execution must preserve proven earlier success and defer re-observation/re-planning to the next reconcile pass, avoiding mid-pass I/O and compound mutation replay
Ticket-local 404 and permanent 4xx failures must isolate to ticket/endpoint scope, while already-gone delete is treated as idempotent success and broad failures stop only their declared scope

Coordinator must produce exact per-ticket tallies of applied/failed/deferred/skipped/recovered outcomes by mapping normalized Disposition vocabulary (11 values) to 5 outcome buckets without fuse thresholds or production cutover
